verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a fresh Q or get caught alone with her E and R both up; you win if you force every fight with her E on cooldown and your W shield already absorbing, stacking health until Heartsteel comes online.

brief.thesis: Camille's kit is built to dictate when fights happen — Hookshot (E) gives her a gap-close and an escape, Precision Protocol (Q) lets her poke with an empowered auto and walk away on bonus move speed — while Sion has zero mobility and wins only by standing, absorbing with W, and forcing trades on a timer she can't dodge. The 51.1% head-to-head win rate over 88 games sits above Sion's overall 49.6%, but the lane and solo-kill edge both go to her, so the matchup is winnable only if you refuse her terms and wait for yours.

theirWindow.when: her E and Q are both up
theirWindow.what: She can poke with Q's empowered auto for bonus damage and move speed, then dash away with Hookshot if you step up, or combo the E knockup into point-blank autos. Do not engage into this — back off and wait.

yourWindow.what: She has no dash to leave the fight, so this is when Cryptic Gaze (Q) actually lands — toggle Enrage (E) for the attack damage, land the stun, and trade autos under your W shield since she's stuck standing there with you.

start.why: Measured as the 62% pick at 50% win rate here — you have no way to punish her Q poke early, so the flat damage reduction and sustain keep you from bleeding HP you'll need for later all-ins.

boots.why: 67% pick, 47.5% win rate — her entire trade pattern is auto-attack based (empowered Q auto, passive attack shield), and flat auto-attack reduction blunts that harder than magic resist does.

core.why: Pairs directly with Enrage's permanent max-health gain on kills, turning your farm into both a tankier body and more stacked damage.
Scales off the health Heartsteel and Enrage are stacking, giving your autos real cleave damage once you're no longer losing the all-in race.
She lives on autos and her passive attack shield — grievous wounds and reflected damage directly punish an auto-attack-reliant kit.

situational.when: she's building lifesteal or heavy sustain to out-trade your health pool
you need more anti-heal and raw tankiness against her sustained auto trades
the enemy team has multiple auto-attackers and you need wave clear on top of it
you're ahead on health and want to convert your stacked max HP into more burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's proc damage and heal scale with max health, which is exactly what Enrage is stacking every time you kill a minion — it keeps you winning the sustain war against her poke lane.

summoners.why: The 88.6% pick rate at 47.3% win rate reflects the matchup: Flash is your only tool to avoid getting caught by her E knockup into R anchor, and Teleport lets you reset tempo after a bad trade instead of contesting a lane where she holds the solo-kill edge.

playing.title: Fight only when her E is down
playing.detail: Hookshot (E) is her gap-close and her escape — once it's on cooldown (16 to 12 seconds by rank) she can't disengage or dive you, so that's when you toggle Enrage and commit.

playing.title: Land Q from brush
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze's 550-range stun is easy to walk out of if she sees the cast coming — using it from inside brush removes her reaction window entirely.

playing.title: Don't trade into a fresh Q
playing.detail: Precision Protocol grants her next attack bonus damage and move speed, with a bigger recast payoff if she delays it — walking into an auto trade right after she casts it is a losing exchange.

playing.title: Hold your W shield for her commitment
playing.detail: Death's Caress's absorb shield is worth more unpopped — let it soak her all-in rather than detonating it early, since the explosion only matters once she's actually in range.

playing.title: Respect level 6 hard
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum lets her dash onto you from 475 range and anchor you in place while her autos deal bonus magic damage — never stand past the minion wave without Flash up once she hits 6.

playing.title: Farm safely to stack health
playing.detail: Enrage permanently raises your max health on every kill — prioritize safe csing under tower over contesting trades until that health lead plus Heartsteel stacks start outscaling her burst.

playing.title: Use Teleport to skip bad fights
playing.detail: Since she holds both the lane and solo-kill edge here, Teleport is there to let you disengage a losing trade and show up to sidelane skirmishes instead, rather than forcing even exchanges she's favored to win.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG — the tactical reading of why those numbers happen (cooldown timing, shield usage, E-dodge windows) is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let her interrupt [Q] using (E). Fight her whenever your skills come off cooldown. Try to hit her with [Q] by using it from inside a brush.
